en-US.octane-logic.adder.title: Adder
en-US.octane-logic.adder.description: Outputs A + B for two integer signals.
en-US.octane-logic.subtractor.title: Subtractor
en-US.octane-logic.subtractor.description: Outputs A - B for two integer signals.
en-US.octane-logic.multiplier.title: Multiplier
en-US.octane-logic.multiplier.description: Outputs A × B for two integer signals.
en-US.octane-logic.divider.title: Divider
en-US.octane-logic.divider.description: Outputs integer A / B. A zero divisor outputs no signal.
en-US.octane-logic.modulo.title: Modulo
en-US.octane-logic.modulo.description: Outputs integer A mod B. A zero divisor outputs no signal.
